title: Tiled upscale asks the tile size first: a card with each size's tile count
description: Fabio 2026-10-23: Cosmo must not start a tiled run and only then say how many tiles. Before a tiled generate with no tileSize named, the app quotes every tile size and shows a choice card (CHOICE_CARDS kind 'tiles'): '512 px - 20 tiles' etc., the click runs it with no agent turn. A 1K square at 1024 is one tile, so small pictures need small sizes offered. Supersedes MPI-1259's auto pick (that rule becomes the card's highlighted pick).
